<translate>
'''Piccolo''' is a [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|master]] who lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Piccolo's House|Piccolo's House]] in the plains of [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. He teaches Potential Unlock and five ki attacks, heals you and hands out weighted capes. He trains anyone, whatever their alignment.
</translate>

<translate>
== Location ==
</translate>
<translate>
Piccolo lives at [[Special:MyLanguage/Piccolo's House|Piccolo's House]], which generates once per world in a plains biome. Capsule Corp Assistants sell a map to it at trade tier 2 (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Piccolo's House#Finding it|Piccolo's House]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Skills and techniques ==
</translate>
{{See also|Skills|Techniques}}
<translate>
* '''Skills:''' [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Control|Ki Control]]
* '''Ki attacks:''' Masenko, Special Beam Cannon, Ki Barrage, Kienzan, [[Special:MyLanguage/Hellzone Grenade|Hellzone Grenade]]
</translate>

<translate>
Everything is paid for with Training Points, and your race has to allow each skill. His '''Train''' option spawns a Shadow Clone to spar with.
</translate>

<translate>
== Services ==
</translate>
<translate>
* '''Heal me''' restores your health, ki, stamina and poise. It's locked when you're already at full health, and doesn't work while you're knocked out after a temporary revive.
* '''Weighted Gear''': type the weight you want and Piccolo gives you a '''Weighted Cape''' of that weight (up to 100,000 kg by default). You can ask once per conversation; talk to him again for more. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Weights|Weights]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Saiyan Saga|Saiyan Saga]] quest 2, ''Piccolo Takes Gohan'': find Piccolo's House and talk to Piccolo.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 4, ''Enter the World Tournament'': talk to Piccolo.
</translate>
